findings.description: The EBS data volume does not set encrypted = true or specify a KMS key, so data written to it may be stored unencrypted at rest unless an account-level default happens to override this configuration.

The instance user-data embeds an AWS access-key ID and secret access key in plaintext. User data is readable through instance metadata and EC2 describe mechanisms and can expose credentials to users with access to the configuration or instance.

No metadata_options block requires IMDSv2, leaving IMDSv1 available by default. An SSRF flaw on this internet-reachable instance could be used to retrieve instance metadata and any attached role credentials.
TCP port 22 is allowed from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing remote administration to the entire internet and enabling broad scanning and brute-force attack attempts.
The security group permits all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0. This provides an unrestricted egress path for data exfiltration or command-and-control traffic from a compromised server.
The bucket receiving VPC flow logs has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so it does not explicitly enforce encryption at rest for stored log objects.
